description: Rede rodoviária 2014 PELT-RS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Malha Rodoviária do PELT-RS 2014 utilizada como base para construção da rede multimodal. Coverage: Rio Grande do Sul. Its tags are Modelagem de Transportes, Rede Rodoviária, PELT, Downloadable Data, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
